description: Six gate lengths played one per clock pulse, so each pulse opens a gate of its own duration

params.text: Sets how long the gate for its own step stays open, 0.1 to 10 seconds on the knob
Chooses whether the sequence runs forwards, backwards or jumps to a random step
Sets the chance that an incoming clock pulse is acted on at all, 0 to 1
Sets how many of the six steps are used, 1 to 6
Steps the sequence once, as a rising edge at the clock jack does

inputs.text: A rising edge steps the sequence on by one and opens that step's gate
With a monophonic cable, a rising edge sends the sequence back to the start and shuts the gate; with a polyphonic cable, a button press copies that cable's channels into the six length knobs instead

outputs.text: Carries the gate at 10V for the length of the step the sequence is on, and 0V between steps

notes: a clock pulse arriving during an open gate is thrown away, so the sequence moves no faster than its longest gate allows
the gate runs for half the time its knob reads, because the source advances the gate generator twice in each sample; a knob at 10 seconds gives a gate of five
the copying from a polyphonic reset cable works from the button only; the source reads the clock jack's edge before it reaches that test, so a clock pulse steps the sequence rather than copying

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
